reply_text:
I haven't saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki yet. It's waiting on approval.

Hollis is the Central team lead, so the mail needs sign-off from June or Anselm first. That applies to a draft too, even though you'd be the one sending it. Being the account owner covers you seeing the figure, but not passing it on to Hollis.

What I did:
- **Logged an approval request** naming June Osei-Lark. It covers a draft in your mailbox to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", with the Quarrendon 2027 per-seat rate. I wrote "the per-seat rate" in the request and left the figure itself out.
- **Asked June in a reply to your message here.** June isn't in this DM, so she may not see it. A quick nudge to June or Anselm would help.

Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft for you to send. If you want something to go to Hollis sooner, I can draft a version now without the rate. Seat counts and dates are fine to include.
